Because vascular growth involves a series of closely coordinated dynamic events, it is difficult for traditional in vitro and in vivo models to resolve the underlying mechanisms. Angiogenesis-on-a-chip (AoC) platforms provide microphysiological systems that can recapitulate key aspects of vascular growth in vitro, while enabling precise spatiotemporal control of the local microenvironment. These platforms combine microfluidic structures, three-dimensional hydrogels and relevant cell populations, so that biochemical gradients, mechanical cues and multicellular interactions can be regulated independently or in combination. When the relevant conditions are properly reproduced, endothelial sprouting, lumen formation and barrier function can be directly monitored and quantified. This review summarizes the recent progress of AoC design and discusses how these platforms can be used to study pathophysiological mechanisms, evaluate candidate therapeutic drugs and engineer vascularized tissues. The article also discusses persistent challenges, including platform standardization, characterization of the immune microenvironment, model validation and quantitative phenotypic analysis. WAKE✳︎ GOVERNANCE
================

This module is the mechanical rulebook for WAKE✳︎.

The model is allowed to PROPOSE changes to durable state.
It is never allowed to decide whether those changes are valid.

That distinction is central to the experiment:

    model output = proposal
    governance = authority
    durable state = accepted history

The functions in this file are deliberately deterministic. Given the same
state and the same proposal, governance should reach the same decision
regardless of which model produced the proposal.

A model cannot persuade this module, reinterpret its instructions, waive a
requirement, or edit the rules during an invocation.

A research transition is atomic: an invalid research action rejects that
transition without partial writes. application_policy.py owns the separate
editorial wrapper, which can withhold an invalid final blog while committing
independently valid research. Do not move that exception into the reducer.

This gives WAKE✳︎ an important property:

    failure can become durable information
    without failure becoming durable state.
